Subject: Initial scope — inference packaging, hub fitting for clinical summaries

Hi Naomi,

Thanks for taking a look at EdgeHealth's inquiry. We're building a clinical summaries product that will call an LLM to normalize notes and generate short summaries for clinician review. We're evaluating vendors for a mix of hosted and eventual private deployment (HIPAA/BAA scope).

High level:
- Expected traffic: ~100k tokens/month to start, with bursts to ~1M tokens during pilot periods.
- Latency target: P95 < 350ms for short prompts (~256 tokens)
- Must have audit logs + retention for 1 year, and the option to move to a VPC/private install later.

Questions we want to cover in the next few days:
1) Which plan should we start on (hosted starter vs. dedicated reserved vs. private)?
2) Do you offer bundled pricing for compliance features (audit logs, extended retention, BAA) + dedicated throughput?
3) Typical timeline to migrate hosted -> private and any migration costs?

I've attached a short RFP notes doc with our priority checklist. Can you send a short pricing snapshot and recommended plan options? Happy to set a 30m call to review. Procurement looped in for process.

Thanks,
Helen Park
Director, Product — EdgeHealth
helen@edgehealth.com

Hi Helen —

Great to hear from you, and thanks for the RFP notes. Short answers up front and then a compact pricing/packaging proposal below. Happy to jump on a 30m call; I'm available tomorrow 10–12 PT or Friday morning.

Start plan recommendation (quick):
- Pilot / PoC: Hosted "Growth" tier — fastest time to value, includes streaming, token-level analytics, and basic audit logs.
- Production (target): Dedicated Standard or Private depending on compliance. If you need BAA and managed private networking, we typically move to Private for full isolation.

Bundled feature options we commonly offer for clinical customers:
- Clinical Compliance Pack: audit logs (1y), HIPAA BAA addendum, extended retention + export tooling.
- Latency & Priority Pack: dedicated GPU pool, priority routing, SLA-backed latency SLOs (P95), and traffic shaping.
- Migration Assist: one-time migration plan, KV cache export/import, and 2 weeks of dedicated rollout support.

Pricing snapshot (very high level, ballpark):
- Hosted Growth (monthly, no commit): $0.0008 per token (ingest+output combined) — good for PoC.
- Dedicated Standard (annual commit recommended): equivalent unit economics ~ $0.0005 per token at 12mo commitment + $2,500/mo base for pool reservation.
- Private (VPC/on-prem): project-based — typical baseline $60k–$120k for initial setup + monthly platform fee (varies by sizing).

Discounting & packaging notes:
- For a 12mo annual commit we can offer a 20% first-year discount on Dedicated pricing, or 15% + 1 quarter of service credits for a faster signature.
- We can bundle the Clinical Compliance Pack at a fixed add-on price to simplify procurement (recommended for pilots turning into production).

I've attached a simple pricing snapshot PDF and a short checklist to help with procurement. Ben (cc) will add a technical sizing note on recommended instance configurations for your expected workload. Monica on legal/BAA will coordinate contract steps.

Next steps:
1) Quick call to validate traffic profile and SLA needs.
2) I can send a draft SOW + pricing addendum for your internal review.
3) If you want, I can propose two paths: (A) monthly hosted to pilot -> dedicated annual commit when you hit a usage threshold, or (B) skip hosted and go straight to Dedicated with migration assist.

When's a good time for the 30m?

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Senior Account Executive — Redwood Inference
naomi_feldman@redwood.com

From: ben_carter@redwood.com

Quick technical notes — adding to Naomi's summary:

- For the volumes you described (100k tokens/month baseline, bursts to 1M), a Dedicated Standard pool sized around 1-2 A100-equivalent GPUs with autoscale burst to 4 GPUs tends to hit your P95 target, assuming model choice similar to a 7B quantized variant.
- If you want to run a 13B/70B model for higher fidelity, expected token cost will increase ~2–4x; we can help with a mixed fleet and smart routing to send latency-critical short prompts to smaller models and long-context requests to larger models.
- Quantization + KV caching reduces per-token compute dramatically; we can include an evaluation window to validate no perceptible quality regression for your clinical prompts.

Tradeoffs:
- Hosted Growth (fast) vs Dedicated (predictable latency): hosted is easiest but gives less isolation. Dedicated + Clinical Compliance Pack covers most regulatory needs short of a fully private install.

Attached a recommended config snippet to accelerate pilot setup. Happy to run a 48-hour load test on our shared staging fleet once we have API keys and test prompts.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
Attachment: inference-config-recommendation.yaml
